Thanks Aisha — this is very helpful. I pulled your asks into a concise acceptance matrix (attached: acceptance_test_matrix_v1.csv) and mapped internal owners. Key notes below and proposed exit gates.

Proposed exit gates (high-level):
- Data ingress validated: synthetic + sample production logs verified (Owner: Karthik)
- Latency SLO: 95th pctl < 350ms on the preprod replica with 50 concurrent users (Owner: Infra runbook)
- Functional accuracy: >=90% recall on the triage intents on the labeled test set (Owner: Marissa)
- Stability: no P1 incidents during two rolling 24-hour runs (Owner: Ben)
- Security & audit: automated audit exports to S3 with IAM-only access and 90-day retention (Owner: Security Ops)

Who runs what?
- Redwood will own: latency smoke runs, stability ramps, audit log verification, and instrumentation for metrics. (Ben + Karthik)
- Keystone will own: labeled test set validation and business acceptance (Aisha).

Action items: please review the acceptance_test_matrix_v1.csv — I called out thresholds and sample test commands. If you confirm by EOD Friday (8/13) we can schedule the preprod smoke run the week of 8/24.

Hi all — following up with the run schedule we discussed. Below is the proposed timeline and owners; this aligns with the MAP doc and the acceptance matrix.

Planned dates:
- 2026-09-07: Preprod smoke run (Redwood infra) — validate latency & basic correctness
- 2026-09-09: Business acceptance test (Keystone) — labeled set validation and edge-case review
- 2026-09-10 - 2026-09-13: Ramp (increasing concurrency to target) — stability and error budget sampling
- 2026-09-14: Certification decision window (stakeholders sign-off)

Rollback / failure modes (short):
- If latency exceeds SLO on smoke run: immediate throttle + revert to smaller concurrency, run diagnostics, remediation window 10 business days.
- If functional accuracy <90%: block to certification; Redwood to provide root-cause and a remediation plan within 5 business days.

Owners:
- Smoke + ramp orchestration: Ben
- Metrics instrumentation and dashboards: Karthik
- Business acceptance + sign-off: Aisha / Keystone stakeholders

Please flag any date conflicts by EOD 9/3. We'll publish detailed test commands in the MAP doc (link below).
